policy: Only extend luckBase/luckAux whitelists. Existing local alchemical extracts can serve both roles; each role consumes its own same-quality unit. Do not change drops, other recipes, prices or effects.

materials.name: 灰根草
materials.rationale: 草根汁液可分别提取为幸运药剂的基液与辅助草浆。

materials.name: 白穗籽
materials.rationale: 既有通用炼金籽仁基浆可分别用作幸运基液与籽粉辅料。

materials.name: 露冠花
materials.rationale: 现有花露、花汁炼金用途可分别作为幸运基液与辅助花浆。

materials.name: 灰帽菌
materials.rationale: 湿润菌肉可分别提取为幸运基浆与辅助菌液。

materials.name: 盐壳碎片
materials.rationale: 已有提纯矿液与矿盐药剂用途可分别作为幸运基液与辅助盐晶。
